scenes.say: Ever wonder how to catch performance issues or crashes in a .NET app? Which tool should you reach for and when?

scenes.label: Counters
scenes.sub: dotnet-counters shows real-time CPU, GC, and threads.
scenes.say: Use dotnet-counters to watch live metrics like CPU, garbage collection, and thread pool activity.
Grab dotnet-trace for deep performance analysis. Use dotnet-dump to capture and inspect memory dumps when things go wrong.

scenes.title: How to use them
scenes.say: Here’s how you run each tool. Just swap in your app’s process ID.

scenes.question: Which tool for a production crash?
scenes.right: dotnet-dump captures a memory snapshot for debugging crashes.
scenes.say: Don’t mix them up! For a production crash, dotnet-dump is your go-to for capturing a memory snapshot.
